access_status.user_request_rule: Try arXiv, author repositories, journal open PDFs, HAL, institutional repositories, CompOSE and Zenodo first. If a relevant original paper remains inaccessible after those routes, ask the user for that specific paper; do not substitute an unrelated review as the original source.
